profile.headline: I turn ideas into meaningful impact.
profile.description: A curious learner exploring the intersection of industrial engineering, technology, and creative problem solving.

about.intro: I enjoy understanding how things work, finding better ways to do them, and turning complex challenges into practical solutions.
about.paragraph: My interests span process improvement, information systems, digital products, and collaborative projects. I believe good work happens when analytical thinking meets creativity and a willingness to keep learning.
